workflow_steps.title: Create hospital point features
workflow_steps.purpose: Spatialize the hospital coordinate table as point features for polygon-based counting.
workflow_steps.instructions: Convert the CSV table to GeoPackage points using the observed latitude and longitude fields. The source CRS must be explicitly confirmed or supplied at runtime if it remains unknown.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Count hospital point features within each census tract polygon in Centre County.
workflow_steps.instructions:
Count the hospital points within the census tract polygons and emit the tract layer with the resulting count attribute. Do not assume or invent field names beyond the observed schemas; runtime QC should ground any optional output-field configuration.
Recovery constraint: Reject the unsuitable candidate and retrieve another candidate satisfying the observed requirement.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis B
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.name: Vector Aggregation and Joins
skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for spatial joins. Requires projected CRS for metric buffer.
other: Accepts GeoPackage (.gpkg) vector format only. Rejects GeoJSON or Shapefiles.
Accepts CSV tables for attribute join operations.
